geometry: Continuous matte weathered metal with broad soft steel/rust mottles and narrow vertical weathering streaks.
No source authority for added panel grids, rivets, trim, symbols or large fractures. Strong native128pixel grain is not geometry to reproduce.

TF_Metal3 is lighter;TF_Metal4 is darker. Within each palette,_02 transitions from blue-grey steel at top to brown corrosion at bottom;_03 reverses that directional composition without being a literal pixel flip.
seamPolicy: Preserve horizontal repeat. Existing smooth x-only colour boundary correction is suitable after photographic fitting.
Do not equalise top and bottom of individual textures or run xy correction: this would erase intended directional transition.
Review _02 bottom against corresponding _03 top (rust), and_03 bottom against_02 top(steel); native pair boundaries are closer than their selfYboundaries.
Preserve family-relative darker/lighter tones and inspect transition joins separately from isolated selftileviews.
minimalRecipe: Reuse a coherent GPT matte-steel material donor if useful, with restrained rustpitting and sparse verticaldrips; use broad original layoutcolour reference only.
Fit each source independently at4x512 with smooth colour/layout fields. Keep native name/pixel identity guards, even if donor art is shared.
Encode every runtime image Q92 through current grayscaleXYZ+decodedheight pipeline; matching relief remains shallow and consistent with matte metal.
Inspect decoded512, both64half, both32quarter, xrepeat/cyclicx, and both directed pairYjoins. Avoid wholeimagebevel/vignette, polishedspecularfeatures or a uniformgrainoverlay.
qualification: This plan does not establish generated art acceptance, encoder correctness, actual renderer or Dev publication.
